title: Basic-tier router token collides with host family hue and is excluded from every separation check
evidence:
+	anchors := [5]rl.Color{
+		p.small_biz_family, p.campus_family, p.residential_family,
+		p.host_family, p.router_tier_mid,
+	}

+SPAWNS = [
+    ("router_mid", 20, 15),

+	p.host_family = jcol(obj, "host_family", {70, 130, 180, 184})
+	p.router_tier_basic = jcol(obj, "router_tier_basic", {124, 136, 152, 102})
detail: Token hues: steel basic ≈214°, host ≈207° — 7° apart. Basic pucks (the default tier) stay in the host-blue hue family this PR exists to separate, and no token-level or blur test ever measures basic/high.
recommended_fix: Add router_tier_basic/high to the anchors array (will fail — retune steel) or document the basic exemption; add basic/high router spawns to blur_gate SPAWNS.

title: Headline blur-test gate is not wired into the CI suite it advertises
evidence:
+## The blur-test gate — every pair hue-separated ≥15°, sat band ≤0.30

+`tools/ci-local.sh` (linux container) — **10/10 gates green**:
+lint/purity, core+app tests (219+), game build, golden harness (45 demos),
+palcheck, drift-rejection, preview cross-check, PP_DEBUG builds, stats
+replay-identity, input parity (27 scenarios).
detail: The PR's acceptance measurement (drawn σ6 separation, sat band) is enforced nowhere automated: the enumerated 10-gate suite omits blur_gate.py; only the token-level test runs, and it omits two tier tokens.
recommended_fix: Add tools/blur_gate.py on the current terminal_types golden (σ6) as an 11th gate in tools/ci-local.sh.

evidence:
+# spawn_node <type> <tx> <ty> at 5000ms (all six spawns are in by then).
+SPAWNS = [
+    ("router_mid", 20, 15),

+    ("campus", 30, 10),

detail: Seven entries follow a comment claiming six spawns. Either the demo table or the count is wrong; a wrong spawn table silently samples canvas instead of nodes, skewing the gate.
recommended_fix: Reconcile the comment (or table) against demos/terminal_types.dem's actual spawn count.

title: blur_gate.py: unused math import and dead worst variable
detail: math is imported but never referenced; worst is assigned in the pair loop but never read or printed afterward. Dead code in a freshly added file.
recommended_fix: Drop the math import; print worst (max pairwise delta) alongside the band or remove the variable.

title: Docstring promises exit code 2 for usage/setup errors; no path returns 2
evidence:
+Exit code 0 = gate green, 1 = gate red, 2 = usage/setup error.

+    return 0 if ok else 1
detail: Only 0/1 are returned. A missing file or malformed flag raises (exit 1 — indistinguishable from 'gate red') or is silently ignored; flag values are never validated.
recommended_fix: Wrap path/argument handling and return 2 on setup failure; reject --sigma/--out with missing values.

title: blur_gate.py committed non-executable despite shebang and direct-invocation usage line
evidence:
diff --git a/tools/blur_gate.py b/tools/blur_gate.py
new file mode 100644

+#!/usr/bin/env python3

+  tools/blur_gate.py [golden.png] [--sigma 6] [--out out.png]
detail: Mode 100644 plus a shebang and a Usage line implying direct invocation tools/blur_gate.py — running it as documented fails with permission denied.
recommended_fix: Commit as 100755, or document invocation as python3 tools/blur_gate.py.

title: Puck-LED palcheck floor silently halved 10 → 5 among otherwise floor-preserving re-pins
evidence:
-	check(count_exact(calm, LED_GREEN) > 10, "puck LEDs", count_exact(calm, LED_GREEN))
+	check(count_exact(calm, LED_GREEN) > 5, "puck LEDs", count_exact(calm, LED_GREEN))
detail: Every neighboring re-pin keeps its floor (play-marking >40, hardware tone >200), but the LED floor is halved with no stated measured count or cause — an unexplained weakening.
recommended_fix: State the measured washed-LED count and use the tightest passing floor, or justify the halving in the comment.

title: draw_type_chip lacks the fam.a==0 guard the wash procs have — unwired roles get an empty chip
detail: terminal_family returns alpha-0 for unwired roles and the wash procs guard fam.a==0, but draw_type_chip still draws a paper chip + outline with no glyph for such roles.
recommended_fix: Early-return in draw_type_chip when fam.a == 0, matching draw_family_wash/draw_family_wash_disc.
